# Banana Claude 3.1.0: Nano Banana 2.1

Banana Claude 3.1 routes Google's Nano Banana 2.1 by default and rewrites the
prompt guidance for today's stronger Claude and Gemini image models.

## Highlights

- **Nano Banana 2.1 by default.** `gemini-nano-banana-2.1` supports 1K, 2K,
  and 4K output, `minimal`, `medium`, or `high` thinking, Web and Image Search,
  video-derived images, and up to 14 references, at about half the previous
  default's 1K list price. Thinking tokens are billed on top of that.
- **Describe the scene.** Prompts are now written as natural, director-style
  descriptions, with short labeled lines only for exact copy, locks, edit
  deltas, and safe areas.
- **Sharper helpers.** The visual architect and critic prompts now match what
  each agent can actually do.

## Model changes

| Model | Status in Banana |
|---|---|
| `gemini-nano-banana-2.1` | Default |
| `gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image` | Fast 1K drafts |
| `gemini-3-pro-image` | Precision, dense text, and final assets |
| `gemini-3.1-flash-image` | Deprecated by Google; only 512 drafts |
| Gemini 2.5 Flash Image | No longer routed |

## Upgrade notes

- A request for 512 now needs `--model gemini-3.1-flash-image` (or
  `model` in MCP). Without it, planning fails before any provider call.
- Plans and saved presets that name Gemini 2.5 Flash Image fail with
  `retired_model`. Recreate those presets with a current model.
- Legacy 1.4.1 presets that used 512 migrate to the deprecated Flash route.

## Platform note

Image generation and editing run on Linux and macOS. On Windows, use WSL.

See the [changelog](../../CHANGELOG.md) for the full list.
